Deleting a Remote from the Plug-in (RX4X Receiver)


  1. Press the receiver button for approximately 3 seconds until the radio LED lights up.

  1. Press and release the DOWN (RADIO) button to the position output you wish to program (Normal is once for Step by Step).
  2. The Key LED will flash a number of times equal to the number of the output selected.
  3. Press the key of the remote to be programmed for at least 2 seconds.
  4. The LED will give one long flash if successful.
  5. To program additional remotes or buttons, repeat step 3.

  4. Press the button on the new remote that you wish to program for two seconds.
  5. Wait 10 seconds and test the new remote.

  1. Power on your garage door opener and ensure it is in programming mode. Refer to your opener’s manual for specific instructions.

  2. If the remote does not work after programming, check the battery and ensure the remote is within range of the receiver.
  3. For dual-channel operation, repeat the programming process for the second channel.
